description: React component for displaying a detailed, expandable role card in the explore section of a career navigator app. Implements UI logic, state management, data extraction, and interaction handlers related to role presentation and selection.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts a value to an array of strings, filtering out falsy or invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into cleaned, sentence-like strings with proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a numeric value between 0 and 100.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role identifier string from a role object with flexible property names.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Aggregates and deduplicates persona skills from various nested properties.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes a skill key for comparison by trimming and case lowering.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds matching skills between persona skills and required skills, preserving order and deduplication.
